contradictions.description: Anti-skip says path_only_acceptance=false, but work-item grades say path-only for 7/9 items
contradictions.explanation: Not a contradiction. Anti-skip path_only_acceptance checks only ACCEPTED_VERIFIED items. The 7 items are ACCEPTED_WITH_LIMITATIONS (separate bucket). Both systems are consistent.
contradictions.r3_action: Document and close. No code change needed.

contradictions.description: dirty_git_state check says 'Git state is clean' but git_status_final declares dirty classified state
contradictions.explanation: Wording mismatch. is_dirty=false is correct (dirty_state_classified=true means the dirty state is classified, not unclassified). The anti-skip check passes correctly. The recommendation text 'Git state is clean' is slightly misleading but technically correct per the checker's intent.
contradictions.r3_action: Document. Do not modify anti-skip checker — the logic is correct.
